qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the temperature sensor to water flange with M21 connection?
What torque should be applied to the temperature sensor to water flange with M51 connection?
What is the torque specification for the temperature switch (5.5°C/17°C) to fuel filter/cylinder head?
What torque is required for the coolant temperature sensor with S38/S50 2-pin plug-in connection?
What is the torque specification for the remote thermometer sensor with 2-pin plug-in connection?
What torque should be applied to the remote thermometer sensor on the coolant flange for S50 engines?
What is the torque specification for the air temperature sensor on S38/S50 engines?
What torque is required for the oil temperature sensor on S38/S50 engines?
How does the torque specification differ between M21 and M51 connections for the temperature sensor to water flange?
qa_pairs.answer: M21 requires 18 Nm while M51 requires 13 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual covers these coolant temperature sensor specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 12-14 Engine electrics, subsection 12.62 Coolant Temperature
